answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared harbor escrow before it can transact, and publish its behavior history in a public atlas of reputations. A violet-flagged identity that misbehaves loses its stake and its atlas record, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes with no refund. Honest agents earn the stake back plus fees, making one real identity far cheaper than a sybil swarm.
